children: Leader's Advantage Acquisition will allow holders to trade Class A ordinary shares and warrants separately beginning November 6, 2026.
Separated Class A ordinary shares will trade on Nasdaq under the symbol LEDR, while warrants will trade as LEDRW.
Units that holders do not separate will continue trading on Nasdaq under the symbol LEDRU.
Each unit includes one Class A ordinary share and half a warrant; only whole warrants will trade after separation.
To separate units, holders must ask their brokers to contact transfer agent Odyssey Transfer & Trust Company.
